intent: Repair source-confirmed gateway and MCP connection reliability gaps identified by diagnostic capture 8597579 while preserving selected-profile identity, verified transport proofs, TLS, bounded retries and existing supervisors.
ownership: data/agent/tool MCP connection and catalogue code
runtime_checkpoint_note: Versioned development checkpoint. No private diagnostic payload, live execution receipt or hardware qualification is asserted.
implementation: Preserve typed MCP error codes and retryability in connection health.
Classify nested TLS failures before generic handshake or timeout messages and pause MCP automatic discovery until explicit reconnect.
Do not count a wrapped local cooldown/preflight rejection as a new physical transport failure.
Qualify the existing singleflight and durable journal paths with a bounded 48-job disconnect/reload soak.

kotlin_mcp_host.scope: Production MCP/network classes with pinned Ktor and MCP SDK, JUnit and MockEngine; Android storage/logging/media boundaries are host stubs.

validation.kotlin_formatter: ktlint 1.3.1 on the four touched Kotlin files; no formatting changes
limitations: No Android SDK or connected device in this child environment.
No live private gateway, OpenRouter certificate-path repair, GPU/NPU throughput or hardware execution qualification.

integration_follow_up: Resolver owner: append health.lastErrorCode and health.failureRetryable to TOOL_RESOLUTION_FAILED/WAITING_RECOVERY; use them when rendering reconnect-required failures.
UI owner: ToolConnectionsViewModel currently reads health.lastError; the new safe fields are available for explicit code/retry status. Do not infer readiness from the saved catalogue.
Root owns architecture index, gateway package manifest and release-scope regeneration; this branch does not modify them.
